structured.approach: I read the six contracted inputs. From the TRD and PRD I read only the ap_portal sections: IF-7, F-12 to F-15, C-8, C-9, T-12 to T-16, AC-19 to AC-21, NFR-3, NFR-7 and NFR-10. I then read every file in the ap_portal checkout: index.js, portal.test.js, package.json, ci.mjs, README.md and CLAUDE.md. This step is not allowed to run shell commands, so I used Read, Glob and Grep. I mapped the approved design B4 for TSK-07 onto the actual code, giving one row per constant, private helper, export, version field and test. I kept the change inside the TSK-07 file budget. I proposed a minimum-code approach: append everything to the existing index.js, so ci.mjs and the require('ap_portal') resolution stay unchanged. I gave no line-count estimate, because no tool computes one. A verifier subagent checked the draft against the inputs and the repository files. It flagged two attribution issues, both now fixed: the step ID "FE-04" was not in any input, and PQ-P7 was attributed to feat.stories instead of feat.prototype.

claims.text: ap_portal currently exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary from src/ap_portal/index.js, with VERSION '2.3.0'.
formatAmount formats through Number(value || 0).toFixed(2), a binary float. It conflicts with D-2026-044, so renderOverdueRisk must not use it, and formatAmount stays unchanged (TQ-2).
renderAgingSummary builds HTML with template strings and escapes nothing, so the new function follows its pattern but adds HTML escaping for id and vendor.

ci.mjs syntax-checks every .js file in src/ap_portal, runs the tests with coverage over src/**, requires coverage of at least 90%, and flags lines matching console.log or eval( and lines longer than 140 characters.
package.json holds version 2.3.0 and the ci script and has no dependencies. Only its version changes, moved together with VERSION in index.js.

The components to create in index.js are RISK_CLASSES, OVERDUE_HEADINGS, the private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, and the exported renderOverdueRisk. The export object is updated additively.

toTwoDecimalString accepts only strings matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$, pads them as text, and otherwise throws TypeError. renderOverdueRisk returns '' for missing, null or [] and throws TypeError for any other non-array rows and for a non-integer days.
The files in budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js. LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary and their tests must not change.
The new unit tests map to AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 and TRD tests T-12 to T-16, including the error-branch tests needed for the coverage bar.
Work happens on branch feature/story with write access confirmed. The branch-name question RAQ-1 is carried.
Existing public signatures are kept and new behaviour is added as a new function.

open_questions: CQ-FE-1 (non-blocking): ap_portal has no stylesheet. Where are the risk-high, risk-medium, risk-low and risk-unknown styles defined? Interim answer: outside ap_portal, because the host page is out of this design. Owner: UX lead.
CQ-FE-2 (non-blocking): confirm the exact next minor version for VERSION and package.json (one minor step from 2.3.0). Owner: Developer.
RAQ-1 (carried, non-blocking): is feature/story the intended branch for TSK-07? Interim answer: use feature/story, with commits prefixed STORY-07.
structured.summary: I wrote the components list for TSK-07 (STORY-07) to task.components.md. ap_portal has one layer of view helpers, so the change is confined to the existing src/ap_portal/index.js: two constants, three private helpers, the exported renderOverdueRisk, and the export and VERSION lines. Two more files change: the version in package.json and new tests in tests/portal.test.js. No new module, dependency or CI change is needed, and LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary stay untouched. A verifier checked the draft against the inputs and the code, and its two attribution issues are fixed. There are no blocking questions.
